readme.version_note: Adds effective torus-projection, common-clock decay, projected-force and pressure estimates

slow_clock.literal_profile: alpha_1(t)=sigma(2t-1)/(1+t); U_alpha=alpha W; f_alpha=alpha' W + alpha^2 (W dot grad) W - nu alpha Delta W
slow_clock.rate: For all h,r >= 0: ||partial_t^h U_alpha1||_C^r + ||partial_t^h f_alpha1||_C^r <= C_h,r (1+t)^(-1-h)
slow_clock.note: After t >= 1, the source profile has alpha_1(t)=1/(1+t).

projection.literal: On T_L^3: Delta phi=div g, Qg=grad phi, Pg=g-Qg, pressure shift p->p-phi; ||partial_t^h Pg||_C^r and ||partial_t^h Qg||_C^r <= S_L ||partial_t^h g||_H^(r+2), ||partial_t^h phi||_C^(r+1) <= S_L d_L ||partial_t^h g||_H^(r+2).

main_theorem.name: OAI.ForcedComputation.torus_slow_effective_computation
main_theorem.literal_scope: SlowFluidProperties 1 nu U plus for every spatial word beta and temporal n, common C>=0 bounds both U and force nu U by C*(1+t)^(-1-n); effective force evaluation and a fixed-particle halting equivalence.

velocity_bound.name: slowFromRest_spatial_time_decay
velocity_bound.scope: All spatial words and temporal derivative orders n, inverse-time rate (1+t)^(-1-n).

force_bound.name: slowFromRest_force_spatial_time_decay
force_bound.scope: Same inverse-time rate for force under ZeroAdvection V.

fluid_contract.name: SlowFluidProperties
fluid_contract.scope: Spatially periodic, solenoidal velocity and force, both mean zero; classical NS solution with pressure identically zero, uniqueness in its declared class.

correspondence.common_mathematical_feature: A theorem-level Lean construction does prove an inverse-time common mixed-derivative rate, contrary to any inference that no related rate theorem exists outside BalancedTransport.
correspondence.structural_difference: The October manuscript uses autonomous W with startup factor sigma(2t-1)/(1+t), whereas the inspected Lean construction uses a log-time evaluation V(log(1+t),x)/(1+t). Equality of the resulting fields is not established by these files.
correspondence.projection_difference: October's general Helmholtz/Poisson projection and pressure shift is not stated by the inspected SlowFluidProperties theorem, which instead asserts solenoidal force and zero pressure for its constructed solution.
correspondence.formalization_index: lean/docs/376.md (blob b43f10df2d8fb85337f2b74abe299de009d0ad38) links September 27 edition; the October 6 correction is not explicitly edition-mapped there.
